## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Platforms

- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Windows x64
- [ ] Portable Core or shared contracts
- [ ] Documentation or release infrastructure only

## Validation

List the exact commands and native/manual checks run. Note every skipped or
unavailable gate and why it remains pending.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated generated or formatting churn.
- [ ] Behavioral changes include tests or explicit native acceptance evidence.
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Publication claims in `docs/PARITY.md` match the available evidence.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private keys, logs, site data, or private source are included.
- [ ] No code, assets, binaries, configuration, or private implementation details were copied from another application.
- [ ] Security, migration, compatibility, and rollback effects are described.
